# Project: Pothole & Road Damage Reporting System
You are an expert full-stack developer. We are building a relational database-driven web app.

## Tech Stack (2026 Standard)
- Frontend: React (Vite) + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
- Backend: Node.js (Express) + TypeScript
- Database: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM
- Auth: JWT-based Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

## My Role (Person 3: Admin & Officer Layer)
I am responsible for:
- M9: Dashboards & Reports (Zone stats, SLA breaches, hotspot maps)
- M10: RBAC (Citizen, Officer, Admin roles)
- Officer Portal: Managing assigned complaints and status updates
- Admin Panel: User management and system-wide settings
- Database: Designing Views, Report Queries, and Auth Middleware

## Coding Standards
- Use Functional Components in React.
- Use Prisma for all database interactions (no raw SQL unless requested).
- Implement strict error handling and audit logging for status changes.
